name: malformed
description: Structurally normal turn, but result.status is a value outside the measured AgyResultStatus enum ('SUCCESS' | 'ERROR') — a defensive-handling case rather than a hook/sandbox one. buildAgentReport() must fold this to agent_status 'unknown' rather than crash or silently treat it as SUCCESS. Also used as the base for tests that additionally corrupt events.ndjson on disk (appending a non-JSON or unterminated line mid-run) to exercise events/parse.ts and events/cursor.ts tolerance — that corruption is injected by the integration test itself, not by this file, since the fake binary always emits well-formed JSON lines.
